verdict.rationale: Lever ships several discrete AI-powered features (AI Form Builder that generates forms from a description, AI-generated interview guides, AI interview transcripts/summaries, and Talent Fit AI matching) that let users offload specific tasks to AI, but there is no evidence of a unified conversational 'assistant' that can be delegated open-ended tasks across the product. Missing for 10: a single built-in AI assistant/agent interface, evidence of multi-step task delegation or agentic behavior, and independent/hands-on confirmation of these AI features working as described.
